ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
1.

The learned counsel Ms. Archana Amin has put an appearance on behalf of the respondent Nos.3 and 4.
2.

The petitioner herein seeks re-determination of compensation on the premise that he is entitled for compensation treating the area in question as "Rural Area" as defined in the Gujarat Right to Rameshbhai Mangubhai vs State Of Gujarat on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118667783/
1

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The assertion in the writ petition is that the term "Rural Area" has been defined in the Rules,
2017 to mean any area except the area covered by any urban local bodies and cantonment board or "Developed Area" declared by the Government.
The contention is that the determination with regard to the area in question being the rural area has not been made at the time of determination of compensation.

The contention is thus NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/172/2024 ORDER DATED:
16/01/2024 undefined that the award dated 30.11.2015 in LAQ/4/DFCC/Surat/Niyol-Award- 3/2015 for proposed Special Railway Project Western Dedicated Freight Corridor compensation is to be modified by re-computation of the compensation qua the land of the writ petitioners by multiplying the market value as determined under Section 26(1) of the LARR, 2013 Act with a Factor 2 and applying all other statutory benefits as per the said Act including solatium and interest admissible on the market rate as per 2013 Act.
3. The learned counsel Ms. Archana Amin appearing for the respondent Nos.3 and 4 would submit that the petitioner herein is not the sole owner of the land in question.

There are other co- owners,
who have not been impleaded in the matter.
The question, therefore, would be of disbursement of compensation.

It is, however, submitted that the respondents have no objection to the re-determination of compensation, as prayed by the writ petitioner, but, in any case, the area in question falling in rural area within the meaning of 2017 Rules and application of factor 2 in accordance with Section 26(1) of the Act, 2013 is to be made by the competent authority.
4.

As factual inquiry is required to be made, we are of the considered opinion that the matter be relegated to the competent authority - Special Land Acquisition Officer, Branch No. 4, Surat for fresh consideration.
In the determination to be made by the competent authority, all attending circumstances/factors are to be taken into consideration.
5. Notice be also provided to the respondent No.3 Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited whose representatives can participate in the process of re-determination.

Rameshbhai Mangubhai vs State Of Gujarat on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118667783/
2 6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Once that determination is made with regard to the area in question falling in the rural area,
necessary amendments/revision in the award dated 30.11.2015 shall be made by the competent authority for re-computation of the market value of the compensation for determination of the compensation and the benefits admissible thereon.
The entire exercise shall be completed within a period of three months from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

7. We may clarify that we have not determined the rights of the parties in the matter of disbursement of compensation and that proper inquiry is required to be made by the competent authority by giving notice and opportunity to all concerned.
8.
With the above direction, the present Special Civil Application is disposed of.
All pending Civil Application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of, accordingly.
Direct service is permitted.
